title: [spec-gap][R-02-030][decision sf-upgrade-hysteresis] Rust rf_health adaptive-SF upgrade lacks upgrade_count hysteresis
description: Req R-02-030 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5 upgrade rule) + adjudicated decision 'sf-upgrade-hysteresis' (spec/decisions.jsonl, 2026-09-02): step-4 upgrade requires upgrade_count >= LICHEN_UPGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD consecutive qualifying cycles; decision explicitly says 'Rust rf_health.rs must match'. DIVERGENT: rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:668-670 applies the upgrade (snr_ema > SNR_GOOD && density < DENSITY_LOW -> sf-1) unconditionally — no upgrade_count field anywhere in rf_health.rs (rg upgrade_count = zero hits). C conformant: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c:279-288 (upgrade_count++/reset) gated at :330-334 with LICHEN_UPGRADE_COUNT_THRESHOLD=3 (gradient.h:192). Python: gradient.py:37,274 has it; adaptive_sf.py:133-134 and ccp.py step 4 do not. Suggested placement: rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs step-4 + RfHealthMetrics fields; optionally align python adaptive_sf.py.
